item.text:
{"program":"domain(person,[saul]).
% Saul does not achieve his goals.
axiom(s1, not(achieve_goals(saul))).
% Saul is not receiving support.
axiom(s2, not(receives_support(saul))).
% Saul does not set realistic goals.
axiom(s3, not(set_realistic_goals(saul))).
% If Saul either regains confidence or builds self-esteem (but not both), then he overcomes adversity.
axiom(s4, rule([xor(regains_confidence(saul), builds_self_esteem(saul))], overcomes_adversity(saul))).
% If Saul meets challenges, then he either becomes discouraged or finds new strength, but not both.
axiom(s5, rule([meets_challenges(saul)], xor(becomes_discouraged(saul), finds_new_strength(saul)))).
% If Saul either uses assistive devices or requires medical attention (but not both), then he is disabled.
axiom(s6, rule([xor(uses_assistive_devices(saul), requires_medical_attention(saul))], disabled(saul))).
% If someone requires medical attention and has a strong will, then they can achieve goals.
axiom(s7, rule([requires_medical_attention(X), has_strong_will(X)], achieve_goals(X))).
% Anyone who achieves success will build their self-esteem.
axiom(s8, rule([achieves_success(X)], builds_self_esteem(X))).
% If Saul faces obstacles, then he either loses motivation or finds new strength, but not both.
axiom(s9, rule([faces_obstacles(saul)], xor(loses_motivation(saul), finds_new_strength(saul)))).
% Saul uses assistive devices.
axiom(s10, uses_assistive_devices(saul)).
% Saul does not overcome adversity.
axiom(s11, not(overcomes_adversity(saul))).
% If someone suffers injuries, then they face obstacles and develop resilience.
axiom(s12, rule([suffers_injuries(X)], and(faces_obstacles(X), develops_resilience(X)))).
% Saul has a strong will.
axiom(s13, has_strong_will(saul)).
% Saul either builds self-esteem or sets realistic goals, but not both.
axiom(s14, xor(builds_self_esteem(saul), sets_realistic_goals(saul))).
% If Saul finds new strength, then he either regains confidence or rediscovers purpose, but not both.
axiom(s15, rule([finds_new_strength(saul)], xor(regains_confidence(saul), rediscovers_purpose(saul)))).
% Saul rediscovers his purpose.
axiom(s16, rediscovers_purpose(saul)).
% If someone recognizes their ability and makes progress, then they can regain confidence.
axiom(s17, rule([recognizes_ability(X), makes_progress(X)], regain_confidence(X))).
% If Saul is disabled, then he is either receiving support or suffering injuries (but not both).
axiom(s18, rule([disabled(saul)], xor(receives_support(saul), suffers_injuries(saul)))).","query":"labelled_explanation(not(loses_motivation(saul)), Status, Package)"}
